{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Re-load the data
sales = pd.read_csv('/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/sales.csv')

# Convert revenue to float
sales['revenue'] = sales['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Filter for NEW customers reached by PAID SEARCH
filtered = sales[(sales['channel'] == 'paid_search') & (sales['customer_segment'] == 'new')]

# Compute conversion rate: fraction of converted orders
conversion_rate = filtered['converted'].mean()

# Print the result
print(conversion_rate)"}
